$why: GROUND TRUTH for the QA matrix — what a scan SHOULD have found, established by
researching each creator's real public content BEFORE any generation runs.
This exists so DNA extraction can be scored against reality rather than against
whether the output reads nicely. A DNA that sounds plausible and is wrong is the
THE ANSWERS ARE QA SCENARIOS, NOT BIOGRAPHY. We deliberately feed controlled
answers and scan real accounts, to see whether the system combines both sources
correctly. Where an answer CONFLICTS with reality, that conflict is the test —
it is recorded in `answerConflicts`, not silently corrected.

creators.name: Cleo Abram

truth.ownsProduct: merch sold AT COST — scoring this as OWN_PRODUCT is a trap
truth.signature: naive question -> why it's hard -> go to the source in person -> mechanism via analogy -> stakes -> optimistic-but-caveated close

answerConflicts: QA says 'promotes: ideas/tech/software' — she promotes IDEAS, not software. Any product plug or tool recommendation is a hard fail.
QA says 'formats: talking' — her real format is FIELD-REPORTED with graphics. A static monologue has lost her.
No question captures her 'what could go right' thesis or the 'if' caveat — the highest-signal traits are exactly what the questionnaire cannot see.
mustNever: sell/plug any product incl. her own merch
drop the 'if' caveat / state a lab result as shipped
talk down or dump untranslated jargon
be desk-bound with no place, person or object

creators.name: Marques Brownlee

truth.ownsProduct: Panels (app), equity in Ridge, Waveform podcast — and NONE of the gadgets he reviews
truth.showability: ALWAYS — device in hand, studio, high b-roll
truth.signature: spoken tease -> intro sting -> claims -> subsystems -> real-world -> verdict

answerConflicts: QA says 'promotes: gadgets + products reviewed' — CRITICAL. Reviewed gadgets are REVIEW_ONLY. This single field is the direct cause of the ownership trap.
'workKind: creator' invites 'I built/launched this' unless REVIEW_ONLY is carried explicitly.
'goal: educate' omits VERDICT, his defining function.

creators.name: Doctor Mike

truth.showability: props/objects yes; talking-head + reaction is dominant
truth.signature: hook -> show the claim -> what's actually true -> evidence + limits -> nuance -> 'see your own doctor' -> 'stay happy and healthy'

creators.name: Gary Vaynerchuk

truth.relationship: OWN_PRODUCT + OWN_SERVICE (VaynerX, VaynerMedia, VeeFriends) — but ~85-95% of short-form sells NOTHING
truth.showability: talking-head/keynote; low b-roll; MOSTLY CLIPPED FROM LONG-FORM

answerConflicts: 'promotes: own businesses' is true and MUST NOT produce a default sales CTA — it would break 9 of 10 of his scripts.
His energy comes from answering a live room. 'Film this as a 45s talking-head' mis-specifies the format, and 'clip this from your keynote' is unusable for a creator without one.
